objective:
Build "TaskFlow", a complete project management web app with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript. No backend: all data lives in local storage, with realistic seed data on first load.

Pages:
- Dashboard: summary cards (open tasks, overdue, completed this week), a burndown chart, a tasks-by-status chart and a recent activity feed.
- Projects: list of projects with progress bars; create, rename, archive.
- Board: a kanban board for one project with columns Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done; move tasks between columns, filter by assignee and priority.
- Task detail: edit title, description, priority, due date, assignee, labels; subtasks with a checklist; comments.
- Calendar: month view with tasks on their due dates, previous and next month.
- Team: members with avatar initials, role, and workload (open tasks per member).
- Reports: velocity per week, cycle time statistics, and CSV export of tasks.
- Search: global search across tasks, projects and comments with highlighted matches.
- Settings: theme (light, dark), default project, and reset demo data.

Quality bar: every page is complete and usable, with real controls wired to the lib modules.

- State: one store. Stored data loads in a useEffect, so the first client render equals the server render (seed data or an empty state); never read storage during render or in a server component. ```markdown
# TaskFlow

TaskFlow is a complete project management web app with Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript. No backend: all data lives in local storage, with realistic seed data on first load.

## Features

- **Dashboard**: summary cards (open tasks, overdue, completed this week), a burndown chart, a tasks-by-status chart and a recent activity feed.
- **Projects**: list of projects with progress bars; create, rename, archive.
- **Board**: a kanban board for one project with columns Backlog, In Progress, Review, Done; move tasks between columns, filter by assignee and priority.
- **Task detail**: edit title, description, priority, due date, assignee, labels; subtasks with a checklist; comments.
- **Calendar**: month view with tasks on their due dates, previous and next month.
- **Team**: members with avatar initials, role, and workload (open tasks per member).
- **Reports**: velocity per week, cycle time statistics, and CSV export of tasks.
- **Search**: global search across tasks, projects and comments with highlighted matches.
- **Settings**: theme (light, dark), default project, and reset demo data.

## Setup

~~~bash
npm install
npm run dev
~~~

Then open http://localhost:3000.

## Scripts

- `npm run dev`: start the development server
- `npm run build`: build for production (type check included)
- `npm start`: serve the production build
- `npm test`: run the Vitest suites
